equations: A=0.8*seed-permuted cyclic P; Sigma_A=0.9I+0.1*11T; Q=Sigma-A*Sigma*A.T. Other regimes interpolate mean 0 to ones and stationary scale 1 to 1.5; correlation scenario uses rho 0.1 to 0.5 with zero mean and unit diagonal. Latent state never resets. Each retained event affects channel i%8. Spike/collective add severity; dependency adds severity*(independent N(0,1)-clean_channel)/sqrt(2), in initial-normal marginal SD units. Anomalies never feed latent recurrence.
schedule: 27 slots at 512+512*i. Mixture type cycles spike,collective,dependency (9 each). Single-type conditions retain the 9 matching slots, preserving paired source/time comparisons. Severity=1+(i//3)%3. Collective/dependency duration=durations[i//9]; spikes last 1. Persistent additive fault at 14848 is a separately flagged stress event, excluded from equal-type-mixture summaries. All event intervals are half-open and test-relative here.
semantic_controls: Counterfactual semantic=legitimate relabels exactly the same collective/dependency observation perturbations as legitimate excursions; spike excursions are also retained but flagged duration 1. Persistent fault is likewise a paired semantic stress control. Opposite-label pairs share source seed and never cross probe folds. There are paired equal event counts per semantic class, not a claim of balanced sliding windows. No empirical balancing on detector outcomes. No-anomaly condition has no injected events.
overlap: Events do not overlap each other; regime transitions may overlap events. Preserve mixed drift/anomaly windows as a separate evaluator stratum. Do not remove overlaps to improve results.
